name: Banco Central do Brasil Olinda (PTAX, market expectations)
summary: OData services of the Brazilian central bank: official PTAX exchange rates for the dollar and other currencies, and the Focus market expectations survey.
description: Olinda hosts many OData v4 services from the Banco Central do Brasil. PTAX serves official daily buy/sell exchange rates (per day or per period, per currency) and the currency list; Expectativas serves the weekly Focus survey of market forecasts for IPCA, Selic, FX and GDP with mean, median and dispersion. $format=json, $top, $filter and $orderby are supported.

endpoints.summary: Official USD rate for a date (dataCotacao as MM-DD-YYYY in quotes)
Rates for a currency over a period

license.name: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL), as listed for the BCB open-data portal catalogue

coverage.geographic: Brazil; PTAX covers major currencies against BRL

agent_notes: Docs and field names are in Portuguese. Dates in PTAX function parameters are MM-DD-YYYY inside single quotes (%27 when URL-encoded) and parameters are passed as @aliases. Each service has its own versao path; see each service's page on the portal.
caveats: The licence (ODbL) was read from the first record in the BCB CKAN catalogue, not per Olinda service.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key; Moedas, CotacaoMoedaPeriodo and Expectativas also answered 200.
